payload.text: Found 1 gene record for TP53, of 125 available: tumor protein p53 [2].

TP53 encodes a tumour suppressor with transcriptional activation, DNA-binding, and oligomerisation domains that responds to cellular stress by regulating target genes involved in cell cycle arrest, apoptosis, senescence, DNA repair, and metabolism [1].
Mutations in TP53 are associated with a variety of human cancers, including hereditary cancers such as Li-Fraumeni syndrome [1].
